dog.description_text:
Meet Snickers

There’s nothing sweeter than a second chance, and Snickers is ready for his! Rescued from a difficult situation in the Bronx, this sweet boy is getting the opportunity to leave his uncertain past behind and begin a much brighter chapter.

Snickers has a loving nature and deserves a home where he can feel safe, adored, and completely at ease. He’s looking for someone who will show him the joys of being part of a family and promise to love him through every stage of life.

All Snickers needs now is a person to call his own and a place where he’ll never have to wonder if he belongs. Let's help this sweet boy find his forever!

Please remember that adoption bios are only a snapshot of each animal. Reach out to our Adoption Team for additional information about Snickers and to learn if he may be the right fit for your home.

All dogs will be altered, microchipped, and receive age-appropriate vaccines prior to adoption.

Interested in adopting or fostering? Need more info on this dog? The first step in the process is filling out an application on our website.
